_about: NIL collectives by name, for the ones whose name does not say collective or fund. A collective PAYS athletes; it is never a sponsor prospect. One entry per line; matched case-insensitively as a whole phrase anywhere in a business name (curly apostrophes and '&' are normalised). Add a name here and every gate picks it up: discovery, cards, the send gate, the team scan and scripts/block-audit.js.
